book.name: Madyu
book.title: Madyu Jisas Krais Manö Aij u Madyu kalɨ kƚiñ rɨka

content: Jisas nɨp dam gapna Pailod nɨp ñɨla
Ram gɨsön rɨka nɨŋöm, God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub gau abe, bɨ manö ud asɨkep gau abe, manö hag nɨŋ hag nɨŋ göm, manö hag adö añɨ löm, Jisas nɨp al pak lun, a gɨla.
Anɨb u, Jisas nɨp nagɨ löm, damöm gapman bɨ kub gapna Pailod nɨp ñɨla.
Judas nagɨ ñɨŋa

Pen Jisas nɨp manö kub hagöm, al pak lɨnɨg geila nɨŋöm, Judas, nɨhön gɨnɨg Jisas nɨp mumug nɨŋbin, a göm, mani uda u, bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub gau abe, bɨ manö ud asɨkep gau abe, kalɨp ju dam ñɨnɨg göm, God sabe gep ram u ara.

Amöm, mani anɨb gau kalɨp ñöl gɨ haga, “Jisas naij gagöp u pen yad nɨp mumug nɨŋbin u, mɨdö umnab. Anɨb u, yad nan si nan naij gɨpin,” a ga. Hageia, kale hagla, “U nan hon wasö. Ne ke nöp anɨg gɨpan,” a gɨla.
Hageila, Judas mani ñɨla anɨbu God sabe gep ram raul u ud yuöm, am nagɨ ñɨŋa.
Bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub gau, mani anɨbu udöm hagla, “Mani anɨbi, bɨ al pak lun, a gun, mumug gɨno u me, God nɨp ñun rö lagöp,” a gɨla.
Anɨg hagöm, manö hag nɨŋ hag nɨŋ göm hagla, “Bɨ mɨlö gau nɨbö apöm umlö, dam rɨgöl gun u, mɨnöŋ naböŋ mɨgan ap rauun,” a göm, am bɨ ap mɨnöŋ udöm rin cög gɨmɨdöp mɨnöŋ naböŋ mɨgan anɨbu raula.

Mɨnöŋ naböŋ mɨgan anɨbu, mumug bɨg ñɨla mani u udöm raula u me, hainö nɨbi bɨ mɨnöŋ naböŋ mɨgan anɨbu, hib “Mɨnöŋ Mɨgan Hagape Halö” a gɨla. Mɨñi u rö nöp mɨnöŋ naböŋ mɨgan anɨbu, hib “Mɨnöŋ Mɨgan Hagape Halö” a gɨpal.

Pen kale mɨnöŋ naböŋ raula anɨbu, bɨ God manö hagep Jeremaia nöd hagöm kalɨ kƚiñ rɨka rö nöp gɨla. Nɨpe God Manö u adɨŋ ap kalɨ kƚiñ rɨköm haga, “Kale mani silpa ñɨn juöl añɨ ap ado gɨ da unbö sɨduŋ laŋ (30) u, Juda nɨbi bɨ hagla mani u yag damöm,
bɨ mɨnöŋ udöm rin cög gɨmɨdöp mɨnöŋ naböŋ mɨgan anɨbu raula. Bɨ Kub yɨp haga rö nöp gɨla,” a ga.
Gapna Pailod Jisas hag nɨŋa
Jisas nɨp damöm, gapman bɨ kub Pailod mɨdeia au arlö nɨŋöl gɨ, Pailod Jisas nɨp haga, “Ne Juda kai kiŋ kub kale mɨdpan aka?” ga. Hageia, Jisas haga, “Me hagpan me u,” a ga.
Pen bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub gau abe, bɨ manö ud asɨkep gau abe, nɨp manö rɨmnap hageila, nɨpe pen manö ap hagaga.
Anɨg gö, gapman bɨ kub Pailod haga, “Manö pen pen hagöm, manö ke ke hagaböl u, nɨŋagan ar?” a ga.
Hageia, Jisas manö pen ap hagagö, Pailod gasɨ iru yabɨƚ nɨŋa.
Juda nɨbi bɨ gau, Jisas nɨp al pak lɨmim, a gɨla

Pen Pailod nɨpe bɨ kub manö ud asɨkep sea adö u asɨk mɨdö nɨŋöl gɨ, nɨbin manö ap hagö, auö haga, “Yad mɨdö nöp sɨbön yaŋ uhön nɨŋbin, bɨ manö kub hagabön bɨ u bɨ aij. Nɨp manö kƚö hagagmön. Yad uhön nɨŋbin anɨbu, gasɨ iru yabɨƚ nɨŋabin,” a ga. Pen Pailod gasɨ nɨpe ke gau nöp nɨŋa, Jisas nan ap gaga; bɨ kub gau nöp nɨp nɨŋlö mulu lugöp daubal. Anɨb u, yad aigöl gem, nɨp hag yuö araŋ, a göm, gasɨ u nɨŋa. Pen Rom gapna bɨ kub u pör mɨ u mɨ u Juda kai Pasopa ñɨn kub u, kalɨp bɨ nagɨman kale ke hag nɨŋmɨdal u, yɨharɨŋ hubɨk yumɨdöp. Ñɨn anɨbu, bɨ naij yabɨƚ ap nagɨ mɨdeia; hib nɨpe u Barabas. Nɨbi bɨ iru nöp ap magum geila gau, Pailod kalɨp haga, “Kalöp bɨ mai yɨharɨŋ hag yunamŋ Jisas, Mesaia u a gɨpal u aka Barabas nɨp hag yunam?” ö ga.
Hagö, bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub gau abe, bɨ manö ud asɨkep gau abe, nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp hagla, “Kale Pailod nɨp hagmim, Barabas nɨp hubɨk yuöm, Jisas nɨp al pak lɨlaŋ,” a gɨla.
Pen Pailod nɨbi bɨ ap magum gɨ mɨdeila gau kalɨp haga, “Bɨ mɨhai i, bɨ an nɨp hubɨk yunam?” ö ga. Hageia hagla, “Barabas nɨp hubɨk yumön,” a gɨla.
Hageila, Pailod haga, “Anɨg hagpim u, Jisas Mesaia u a gɨpal u, nɨp nɨhön gɨnam?” ö ga. Hageia, kale magöŋhalö hagla, “Nɨp mab ba laŋ al pak lɨlaŋ!” a gɨla.
Hageila, Pailod haga, “Pen nɨhön? Nɨpe nan nɨhön nan gɨ naij göp?” ö ga. Hagö, manö haga u nɨŋagöm, manö dap ranöm hagla, “Nɨp mab ba laŋ al pak lɨlaŋ! Nɨp mab ba laŋ al pak lɨlaŋ!” a gɨla.

Hageila, Pailod gasɨ nɨŋa, manö yad udagnaböl; pen manö rɨmnap halö kalɨp hag ñɨnö, pen pen paköl rö löp, a gɨ gasɨ nɨŋa. Anɨg nɨŋöm, nɨbi bɨ gau amgö ilö kale gau, ñɨg udöm ñɨmagö ñɨg lɨ lɨ göm, kalɨp haga, “Bɨ anɨbi nɨp al pak lɨnɨg gabim u, manö anɨbu yɨp auagnab; kale ke ado gɨ aunab,” a ga.
Hageia, nɨbi bɨ gau magöŋhalö hagla, “U wip nabɨc hon ke! Hagape nɨpe hanɨp apöm, ñɨ hon gau arnab! Manö anɨbu, hon abe, ñɨ pai hon gau abe aunab!” a gɨla.

Anɨg hageila, Pailod kalɨp Barabas nɨp hubɨk yuöm, Jisas nɨp ami bɨ nɨpe gau ña nɨŋöm kale nagɨ ud Jisas pakla. Anɨg gɨlö, Pailod nɨpe Jisas nɨp mab ba laŋ al pak löl, a göm, ami bɨ nɨpe gau kalɨp ña.
Ami bɨ gau Jisas nɨp hag jula
Gapna Pailod ami bɨ nɨpe gau, Jisas nɨp udöm, dam ram kub kale u amöm, ami bɨ yɨharɨŋ gau kalɨp magöŋhalö wɨñ allö,
ap magum göm, waƚɨj nɨp u ud juöm, waƚɨj aɫɨ, bɨ kub yɨmbal rö ap dapöm, nɨp yɨm ñɨla.

Yɨm ñöm, nagɨ kalɨ kalɨ halö gau dapöm, kiŋ kai rol gɨpal rö usajɨl bad ap göm, nɨp rol gɨ ñöm, bɨ kub gau ur udpal, a göm, gamɨƚ mɨlö ap ud Jisas nɨp ñɨmagö yɨjɨg u ñöm, apöm nɨp kugom yɨmöm, hag juöl gɨ hagla, “Bɨ kub ne auban? Juda kai kiŋ kale ne auban?” ö gɨla.
Anɨg hagöm, nɨp kɨñu alöm, gamɨƚ mɨlö anɨbu ju udöm, nɨp nabɨc cög laŋ pakla.
Pen Jisas nɨp anɨg göl hag juöm, waƚɨj aɫɨ nɨp yɨm ñɨla u ud ju yuöm, waƚɨj nɨpe ke yɨm ñöm, nɨp mab ba laŋ al pak lɨnɨg, uɫ gɨ ud arla.
Jisas nɨp mab ba laŋ al pak lɨla
Adan aŋ gau amöl gɨ nɨŋla, Sairini daun nɨbö bɨ ap aueia. Hib nɨpe u Saimon. Nɨp nable paköm, kƚö göm hagla, “Jisas nɨp al pak lɨnabun mab i ud aru,” a gɨla.
Haglö, nɨpe udöl gɨ, ram mɨnöŋ Golgoda dum arla. Golgoda a gɨmɨdal u manö iƚ u, “Wip Nabɨc Cög Ij.”
Pen dum anɨbu amjaköm, ami bɨ gau ñɨg wain udöm, ñɨg asɨ ap udöm, halö ud ado malo göm, Jisas nɨp ñeila, pen nɨpe ñɨŋ nɨŋöm arö ga.
Jisas nɨp mab ba laŋ al pak löm, waƚɨj nɨp gau nɨme lɨ ke ke udnɨg, sadu rö göm udla.
Anɨg göm, Jisas nɨp mab ba laŋ al pak lɨla iƚ au asɨköm, abad nɨŋ mɨdeila.
Jisas nɨp al pak löm, mab ba laŋ kalɨ kƚiñ rɨkla: BƗ I JISAS, JUDA KAI KIŊ KALE ME I.
Pen Jisas nɨp al pak löm, bɨ nan si udep mɨhau, ap böŋ lap, ap böŋ lap, al pak lɨla.

Nɨbi bɨ adan majö ap ran ap lug geila gau, nabɨc cög gor mar göm, nɨp hag juöm hagla, “Ne God Ñɨ nɨpe rö! God sabe gep ram u ud waƚ gɨ yumön, ñɨn mɨhöp nɨgaŋ kauyaŋ gɨ lɨnabön u me, mab ba laŋ arö gɨmön lugö, hon nɨŋun!” a gɨla.
Bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub gau, bɨ lo manö hag ñeb bɨ gau, bɨ manö ud asɨkep gau, kale u rö nöp nɨp hag juöm hagla,
“Nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap kalɨp gajɨp kamɨŋ arbal, pen nɨpe ke anɨg gɨnɨm rö lagöp. Isrel Kiŋ kub hon u, mab ba laŋ arö göm, mɨnöŋ iƚ i lugö, nɨŋö hagöp a gun, nɨp nɨŋ udun.
Nɨpe God nɨp nɨŋ udöm hagöp, ‘Yad God Ñɨ nɨpe,’ a göp. God nɨpe ke u rö nöp gasɨ nɨŋeinab u, mɨñi apöm, nɨp ud kamɨŋ yuaŋ,” a gɨla.
Bɨ nan si udep Jisas aip al pak lɨla mɨhau, kale u rö nöp, nɨp manö naij anɨbu rö nöp haglö.
Jisas uma
Ñɨn anɨbu sɨdö aŋ aulɨk magö u, sɨbön apöm, mɨd damöm sɨdö gamɨŋ ga magö u kauyaŋ mailö ga.
Sɨdö gamɨŋ ga magö u, Jisas wɨñ kub al hagöm haga, “Eli, Eli, lama sabakdani,” a ga. Haga anɨbu, “God yad. God yad. Yɨp ai gɨnɨg arö gɨpan?” ö ga.
Anɨg hagö, nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap söl anɨb au mɨdeila gau nɨŋöm hagla, “Bɨ anɨbi bɨ God manö hagep Ilaija nɨp wɨñ alab,” a gɨla.
Anɨg hagöm, bɨ ap am nan adɨŋ us hain rö bad ap ud dapöm, ñɨg wain asɨ u rauöm, gamɨƚ mɨlö ap udöm, abös alöm, ñɨnö ñɨŋaŋ a göm, ña.
Anɨg göm ñö, bɨ rɨmnap hagla, “Arɨk! Agamɨj nɨŋ mɨdaiun. Ilaija apöm, nɨp ud kamɨŋ yunab aka?” gɨla.
Pen Jisas kauyaŋ wɨñ kub al hagöm, ake bad mɨdeia u ur ga.
Magö anɨbu nöp, waƚɨj mɨlö kub God sabe gep ram raul mɨgan yaŋ, ajöŋ pak pɨƚ gɨla u, aŋ yaŋ pak bɨƚɨƚɨ göm lap ke lap ke ara. Anɨg gö nɨŋöl gɨ, munmon udöm, kabö gau pa bu göm,
wip kabö mɨgan rɨgöl göm pak pɨƚ gɨla gau, mɨgan hiɨköm, God nɨbi bɨ uɫ nɨpe nöd umla rɨgöl gɨla gau, iru nöp gö, kauyaŋ urakla.
Uraköm, kabö mɨgan gau arɨk höŋ amöm, Jisas uraka ñɨn u kale daun kub uɫ Jerusalem areila, nɨbi bɨ iru nöp kalɨp waiö lɨlö nɨŋla.

Pen munmon udöm, nɨhön nɨhön ga u nɨŋöm, ami bɨ kub u abe, bɨ nɨpe gau aip mɨdeila gau abe, kale anɨnɨn gö pɨñɨŋ göm, mɨdmagö kale arö nɨŋöl gɨ, kale hagla, “Yaue! Bɨ i nɨpe God Ñɨ nɨpe nɨŋö yabɨƚ!” a gɨla.
Pen nɨbi iru nöp apöm, ke ke au mɨdöm, nɨŋ mɨdeila. Nɨbi anɨb gau Jisas nɨp gɨ ñɨnɨg Galili nɨbö aula.
Nɨbi mɨdeila anɨb gau ap Maria Magdala u, ap Jems aip Josep aip nɨme Maria u, ap Sebedi ñɨ nɨpe mɨhau nɨme u.
Josep nɨpe Jisas hañ romaŋ dam kabö mɨgan ap rɨgöl ga

Bɨ gep yabɨƚ ap, Josep, Arimadia daun nɨbö u, nɨpe Jisas bɨ nɨpe ap mɨdeia. Bɨ anɨbu, Jisas umöb nɨŋöm, dugo dugo magö u apöm, gapna Pailod nɨp, Jisas hañ romaŋ u udnam aka gö, Pailod yau a göm, bɨ nɨpe gau kalɨp hagö, Josep nɨp ñɨla.
Jisas hañ romaŋ nɨpe u Josep nɨp ñɨlö, nɨpe waƚɨj rud aij ap udöm, wip he mɨlö u magöŋhalö wam haluöm,
dam kabö mɨgan gɨsön nöp ap, yɨp rɨgöl gɨnaböl, a göm, ju ƚu lɨla mɨgan u rɨgöl göm, kabö haƚai kub ap ud gau ga gɨ dam ajöŋ pɨƚ göm ara.
Nɨbi mɨhöp mɨdailö, nɨbi ap Maria Magdala, nɨbi ap Maria ap. Nɨbi Maria mɨhau apil nɨŋ mɨdlö nɨŋöl gɨ, Josep anɨg göm rɨgöl ga.
Ami bɨ gau wip he rɨgöl gɨla kabö mɨgan u abad mɨdeila

Jisas umö rɨgöl gɨla ñɨn anɨbu, God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub gau abe, bɨ Perisi gau abe, God nɨp sabe gɨnɨg ñɨn u rol, a göm, nan gɨ dap jɨn gɨla. Pen ruö, God nɨp sabe gɨnɨg ñɨn kale u me, gapman bɨ kub Pailod mɨdeia au arla.
Amöm hagla, “Bɨ kub. Bɨ piral hagep anɨbu haga, ‘Yad umem, ñɨn mɨhau nɨgaŋ u uraknabin,’ a ga.

Anɨb u, ne bɨ rɨmnap hagö, ñɨn mɨhöp nɨgaŋ wip rɨgöl u abad mɨdaiöl. Wasö u, bɨ nɨpe gau apöm, wip he mɨlö u si udöm, nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp piral hagöm hagnaböl, ‘Nɨpe kauyaŋ uraköp,’ a gɨnaböl. Anɨg gɨlö, Jisas nöd manö piral haga u nan pro; kale hainö manö piral hagnaböl u kub yabɨƚ gɨnab,” a gɨla.
Hageila, Pailod kalɨp haga, “Anɨb u, kale ami bɨ bad ap udmim, wip rɨgöl gɨla gau ammim, gasɨ kale ke nɨŋ aij gɨmim, wip rɨgöl kabö lɨ pɨdöŋ gɨpe, ami bɨ abad nɨŋ mɨdaiöl,” a ga.
Hagö, Juda bɨ kub anɨb gau amöm, ajöŋ pɨƚ gɨla kabö kub u urön rö göm, ami bɨ bad u haglö, anɨb au nɨŋ mɨdeila.
